{"itinerary": [{"action": "meet", "person": "<PERSON_NAME>", "start_time": "<HH:MM>", "end_time": "<HH:MM>"}]}. Make sure to include the person's name for each meeting.

- Start at Union Square at 9:00 AM.

- Travel to The Castro (13 minutes) to meet Robert before his window ends at 2:15 PM.  
- Travel to Pacific Heights (16 minutes) to meet Sarah early in her window.  
- Travel to Presidio (11 minutes) to meet Nancy at the start of her window.
